purpose: Provide the missing interpretability gate for negative cross-species transfer. A species panel may be called lineage-conditioned only when its IBD-residual turnover is spatially predictable from other endpoint-disjoint edges within the same species at the same geographic scale, while cross-species transfer is not supported. Otherwise a negative cross-species result is NOT_EVALUABLE.

geometry.source: the same frozen 221-species Decker geometry and primary 111/110 split
geometry.target_edge_safety: For target edge (i,j), same-species predictor training edges must share neither locality i nor locality j. No target endpoint may contribute a response value to its own prediction.

response.input: endpoint-safe rank-IBD residual turnover from the already-frozen genetic TTF trait construction
response.self_field: For each target edge, construct the same Gaussian spatial field form from endpoint-disjoint edges of that species only, with equal total weight one over the eligible same-species training edges and the frozen prior; integrate prediction over the same five target-edge segment points.
response.species_score: W_s = Spearman(predicted self-field turnover, observed IBD-residual turnover) across all target edges with an estimable endpoint-disjoint predictor
response.panel_statistic: W = arithmetic mean of finite W_s across the frozen 110 held-out species

synthetic_qualification.null_calibration: Use an independent null reference distribution for the upper-tail W test; do not choose a threshold from the private-positive worlds.
synthetic_qualification.type1_gate: Wilson 95% upper bound of null rejection rate <= 0.10
synthetic_qualification.power_gate: Wilson 95% lower bound of private-A2 detection power >= 0.80
synthetic_qualification.failure: If either gate fails, within-species detectability is NOT QUALIFIED and no empirical negative cross-species result may be interpreted as lineage-conditioned.

empirical_classification_if_both_gates_a.transferable_place_component: cross-species profiled-private p <= 0.05 with positive held-out T; self detectability may be reported but is not required for this label
empirical_classification_if_both_gates_a.lineage_conditioned_spatial_structure: cross-species profiled-private p > 0.05 AND within-species self-coherence p <= 0.05
empirical_classification_if_both_gates_a.not_evaluable: cross-species profiled-private p > 0.05 AND within-species self-coherence p > 0.05, or the self-detectability method failed synthetic qualification
empirical_classification_if_both_gates_a.claim_boundary: lineage-conditioned means spatial structure exists within species but did not transfer across species under the frozen design; it is not proof of a particular demographic history or causal lineage mechanism

forbidden: using shared-species outcomes to choose the self-field bandwidth
allowing target-edge endpoints into the same-species training response set
changing the self-score or synthetic gates after empirical genetic outcomes are opened
calling a cross-species non-result lineage-specific when self detectability is absent or unqualified
